tools.name: find_free_stuff
tools.description: Returns free local finds near a US ZIP code, ranked by estimated resale value and profit. New connectors get 5 full-feed queries with source links free before Pro gating kicks in.

tools.name: area_summary
tools.description: How many free finds are near a ZIP right now and their total estimated resale value. Works for everyone (no Pro required).

tools.name: my_vault
tools.description: Lists the finds the user has saved to their Freebox vault. Pro only.

tools.name: my_alerts
tools.description: Lists the user's Freebox alerts (keyword / category / min-profit triggers). Pro only.

tools.name: save_to_vault
tools.description: Saves a listing (by its id, e.g. from find_free_stuff) to the user's vault. Pro only.

tools.name: remove_from_vault
tools.description: Removes a saved listing (by id) from the user's vault. Pro only.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Creates a Freebox alert that flags matching free finds. Provide at least a keyword or a category. Pro only.

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description: Deletes one of the user's alerts by id. Pro only.

tools.name: create_ebay_listing
tools.description: Takes a free find (by listing_id or title/resale value) and generates a complete, ready-to-sell eBay listing package including optimized SEO title, price recommendation, shipping viability, net profit breakdown, and pre-filled 1-click eBay sell URL.
